program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 12.0, 25.0),    # mirror devices M1/M2 (moderate/weak inversion -> low Vdsat)
    "L1":    (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),       # long L: high ro of M2, good matching
    "gmidc": (20.0, 10.0, 25.0),    # cascode devices
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.5, 4.0),
    "vds1":  (0.10, 0.06, 0.20),    # target Vds of M1/M2 (sets compliance vs. accuracy)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iin", spec.get("iref", 20e-6))
    iout_t = spec.get("iout_target", 80e-6)
    vnom = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    ratio = max(1, int(round(iout_t / iref)))
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # Mirror pair: reference M1 at Iref, output M2 = ratio identical fingers
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iref, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iref * ratio, vds=vds1)

    # Cascodes (source sits at vds1 -> body effect included)
    vds_c1 = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.05)
    mc1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], iref, vds=vds_c1, vsb=vds1)
    mc2 = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], iref * ratio, vds=vnom - vds1, vsb=vds1)

    # Bias resistor: Vg_cas = Vgs1 + Iref*R = Vds1 + Vgs_c
    vR = mc1.vgs + vds1 - m1.vgs
    R = max(vR / iref, 10.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # reference branch: iin -> R -> g1 ; Mc1 (gate = iin node) ; M1 (gate = g1)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "g1", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "g1", "iin", "x1", "vss", mc1, m=1)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "g1", "vss", "vss", m1, m=1)
    # output branch
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", mc2, m=ratio)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "g1", "vss", "vss", m2, m=ratio)

    # Predictions
    ro2 = 1.0 / m2.gds
    roc = 1.0 / mc2.gds
    rout = roc + ro2 + (mc2.gm + mc2.gmbs) * roc * ro2
    v_comp = vds1 + 0.8 * mc2.vdsat
    # residual error: cascode Vds difference -> small x1/x2 offset through DIBL
    dvx = (mc2.gds / max(mc2.gm + mc2.gmbs, 1e-12)) * abs((vnom - vds1) - vds_c1)
    err = 100.0 * (m2.gds * dvx / (iref * ratio))
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "power": 1.8 * iref + vnom * iout_t}
